normativeObservations: The ordinary entity field sequence starts at group 70 flags and includes version/flag-gated optional fields.
For R2000+, the first vertex is 2RD and subsequent X/Y coordinates are DD values relative to the previous point.
Bulges, R2010+ vertex identifiers, and widths are separate conditional arrays.
The modeler subentity begins with an RL byte count followed by a B byte block excluding common entity data.
The B block is described as starting at LWPOLYLINE flags (BS) and ending at the width array (BD).
Three RC fields follow and are each labeled unknown byte.
This wrapper description does not specify the embedded block's complete AC1027 field encoding or explain the observed non-byte suffix.

fastestWitnessPlan: Use AutoCAD 2013/ObjectARX to author one small AC1027 DWG and its matching R2013 DXF; do not use ODA File Converter as the producer while its local bundle is unusable/unverified.

Place a default-options surface and one surface with distinct non-default option values in the same drawing; use API getters before save and after reopen to record the exact source entities, path/profile, options, and handles.

Hash and retain both scratch files; verify AC1027 magic and producer build. Correlate the DXF values with ODA v5.4.1 plus source-bound libdxfrw and independent-reader cursors to identify embedded boundaries, physical suffix, handle roles, and next-frame alignment.

Treat API state, DXF values, ODA round-trip, and peer-reader agreement as separate corroboration. None alone proves DWG byte spans or geometry semantics. Preserve unresolved suffix bytes and keep strict output refused until all P4-C exit conditions pass.
